Today, a candidate build of macOS Tahoe 26.7 includes a short video that purportedly demonstrates the "Visual Intelligence" feature of Apple's rumored camera-equipped AirPods. Let's take a look.

macOS 26.7 Contains Demo Video of Camera-Equipped AirPods

MacRumors yesterday discovered a short video in the macOS Tahoe 26.7 candidate build, in which a man wearing AirPods appears to be asking Siri to record the book he is reading, while Siri's voiceover says:

The video does not show the camera itself; the appearance of the earbuds is very similar to the current AirPods Pro, with the most obvious difference being that the earbud stems appear to be slightly thicker.

Aaron Perris also posted the same video on the X platform:

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple may launch camera-equipped AirPods later this year, with the internal codename B790. Earlier, MacRumors had also found B790-related information in the macOS 26.7 candidate build, including code for "image streaming."

Interestingly, these AirPods are a different product from another camera-equipped model with the internal codename B798, which is expected to launch in 2027.

Judging from Apple's choice to include this demo video in the macOS 26.7 candidate build, these camera-equipped AirPods are very likely to make their official debut at next month's iPhone event.

What are your thoughts on this video? Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section.
